$comment: ADR-0026 §2 — the GLOBAL-DEFAULT shared surface for this stack. A change to any of these files shifts every scenario's shared_hash (⇒ a fresh positive-smoke addendum per scenario), so keep the list to the plumbing scenarios genuinely share: fault-delivery / arm libs, compose, alert rules. Paths are relative to the stack dir. NOTE: when the arm split (PR #48) merges, add scripts/arm-regress.sh and scripts/arm-fire.sh here (arm-incident.sh becomes a thin composer).
